title: Connection settings accept a host/port the bridge route always refuses
body:
## Summary
The connection bar's Save/Connect accepts any host and any port text, while `/api/blender-mcp` connect only accepts a loopback host and an integer port 1-65535; with autoConnect on, the store retries that deterministic 400 five times.

## Description
`src/components/blender-mcp/BlenderConnectionBar.tsx:91` calls `setSettings(editHost, Number(editPort), autoConnect)` with no validation, and the store's `setSettings` (`src/stores/blenderMCPStore.ts`) persists it verbatim (a typed 'abc' port persists NaN, serialised as null). The server rule is `connectTargetError` at `src/app/api/blender-mcp/route.ts:15-21`. Two implementations of one rule, only the server one enforced. On any connect error the store calls `scheduleRetry` when autoConnect is on, so a validation failure that can never succeed burns BLENDER_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS (5, `src/lib/blender-mcp/diagnostics.ts:23`) backoff cycles up to 30s apart. The 2026-07-16 bug scan (`docs/harness/bug-ui-scan-2026-07-16/blender-mcp-integration.md:11`) still describes saving a "remote machine's IP", which the route now refuses. Fixed: move `connectTargetError` to a client-safe shared module, validate on Save (inline error with the same sentence), and never schedule a retry for a target the rule refuses.

## Flow
- Settings -> host 192.168.1.5 -> Save -> autoConnect on -> connect -> 400 'host must be a loopback address'
- store schedules retry -> 5 more 400s over about a minute, pill reads "Reconnecting… (attempt n)"
- fix: shared validator -> Save refuses with the same sentence -> no request, no retry

## Expected impact
Users who type a non-loopback host or a bad port get the reason at Save time instead of a minute of futile reconnects. Risk: a persisted remote host is now refused at Save, which matches what the route already does.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - client and server agree on a valid connect target
Before: 1 + 5 fetches for an invalid host under autoConnect (walked from the code, MAX=5)
After: 0 fetches, validation message at Save (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked the code path; the shared validator belongs in src/lib/blender-mcp (sibling context) and the bar in src/components/blender-mcp (not this round's file_paths)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/app/api/blender-mcp/route.ts:15-21 connectTargetError (server rule)
src/components/blender-mcp/BlenderConnectionBar.tsx:91 setSettings(editHost, Number(editPort), autoConnect)  // no validation
src/stores/blenderMCPStore.ts connect(): if (get().autoConnect) scheduleRetry();  // any error, incl. a 400
src/lib/blender-mcp/diagnostics.ts:23 BLENDER_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
instrument: store test: setState({autoConnect:true, host:"192.168.1.5"}), fetch mocked to the 400 sentence, advance fake timers past 6x blenderReconnectMax, count fetch calls (Before 6, target <=1); plus a BlenderConnectionBar test that Save with port "abc" shows the validation error and persists nothing

title: Three sibling blender-mcp routes still 500 on a malformed JSON body
body:
## Summary
`generate`, `generate/import` and `assets/download` read `await req.json()` raw inside withRoute, so a non-JSON or JSON-null body returns 500 with the engine's error text instead of 400.

## Description
This round fixed the same defect in `src/app/api/blender-mcp/route.ts` and `src/app/api/blender-mcp/execute/route.ts` with `readJsonObject` (`src/app/api/blender-mcp/_lib/body.ts`, commit aef4589b). The unfixed half of the pair: `src/app/api/blender-mcp/generate/route.ts:13`, `src/app/api/blender-mcp/generate/import/route.ts:13`, `src/app/api/blender-mcp/assets/download/route.ts:12`. `withRoute` (`src/lib/api-utils.ts:62-68`) maps every throw to 500 and logs it as a server error. Fixed: adopt `readJsonObject` + `MALFORMED_BODY_ERROR` in the three routes.

## Flow
- POST /api/blender-mcp/generate with body '{not json' from the operator origin -> SyntaxError -> 500 + logger.error
- POST with body 'null' -> TypeError on body.provider -> 500
- fix: readJsonObject -> 400, nothing dispatched

## Expected impact
Callers get a 400 they can act on and server logs stop recording caller mistakes as faults. Risk: only the status code changes.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - caller mistakes answer 400
Before: 6 of 6 malformed cases (2 bodies x 3 routes) return 500 (same mechanism measured red on the two fixed routes)
After: 0 of 6 (predicted; the fixed routes went 4 of 8 red -> 8 of 8 green)
Method: simulation - the mechanism was gated on two routes; these three are outside this round's file_paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: extend src/__tests__/api/blender-mcp-malformed-body.test.ts with the three routes (operator origin, bodies "{not json" and "null"), expect 400 and no svc call: red 6 -> green 6

title: Generation provider set and its refusal copy maintained by hand in 4 places
body:
## Summary
The accepted generation providers live as a type union, a hand-written runtime array, and a hard-coded refusal sentence repeated in three routes.

## Description
`GenerationProvider` is `'hyper3d' | 'hunyuan3d'` at `src/lib/blender-mcp/types.ts:112`; `src/app/api/blender-mcp/_lib/provider.ts:3` repeats it as `PROVIDERS` with no compile-time link (adding a member to the union type-checks clean while the guard keeps refusing it); and 'provider must be hyper3d or hunyuan3d' is copied in 3 route files under `src/app/api/blender-mcp/generate/`. Fixed: export `GENERATION_PROVIDERS = [...] as const` from types.ts, derive the type from it, have provider.ts import it and export a refusal sentence built from the array.

## Flow
- add 'tripo' to the union -> tsc 0 errors -> isGenerationProvider('tripo') false -> 400 with a sentence that omits it
- fix: one array -> type, guard and sentence all follow

## Expected impact
A future provider is enabled by one edit instead of four. Risk: low; three routes change an import.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one source for the provider set
Before: 2 definitions of the set + 3 copies of the sentence; drift is invisible to tsc (0 errors when the union grows)
After: 1 definition; guard and sentence derived
Method: probe - grep counts on the real tree; the derived form needs types.ts (blender-mcp-bridge sibling) and the generate routes (not this round's paths)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: grep count of the literal sentence and of provider literal arrays outside types.ts (Before 3 + 1, target 0 + 0), plus a type-level assertion that typeof GENERATION_PROVIDERS[number] equals GenerationProvider
